format: per mode (A hips lead / head looks, B whole body turns), per direction (degrees clockwise from the look; 90 = right, 180 = back): per tick part rot (xRot,yRot,zRot rad, model space before the body yaw), offset_px from the vanilla pivot, body_yaw_deg (clockwise from the look), travel_deg, roll_deg (bank, + = right side down), pos (right, forward, up blocks from the start), glow. 20 ticks a second.
rule_A: body yaw = travel clamped to +-70 on the ground; > 90 off the look: backpedal (yaw 0.35 x the back angle) and fly back-first (BACKFLY) facing the look; head yaw = -(body yaw) clamped to +-75
